item.title: github: Look up a resource’s cost center with the GitHub REST API
item.description:
GitHub REST API now supports looking up the cost center for a user, organization, repository, or enterprise team. This replaces the previous need to enumerate all cost centers to find the matching one.

  • Source: GitHub
